title: Doozy Vape Co Seriously Donuts Apple Fritter 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Doozy Vape Co.’s Seriously Donuts Apple Fritter e-liquid captures the warm, comforting taste of a classic bakery favourite. It features a soft, airy Donut flavour base that gives way to rich, sticky-sweet Caramelised Apple notes. To complete the experience, a smooth Sugar glaze coating provides a balanced and deeply satisfying bakery vape. This convenient 100ml shortfill bottle really helps your favourite e-liquid go the distance and comes with 25ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. For example, adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. This e-liquid’s 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , vaping mods and sub-ohm tanks .
